standfirst: The best sageuk of 2023: the Qing invasion, a man who refuses to be noble about anything except one person, and a second half that keeps raising the price. An 8.9 from 21,000 ratings, and it earns every point of it. These six are for the historical romance that costs something.

picks.why: History as the thing that decides whether love is allowed. Same structure: a nation being taken apart and a romance that has to be conducted in the gaps. Both are beautiful and both are cruel about it. Difference: it is slower, more political, and the ending is final in a way My Dearest is not.

Devotion inside a court that forbids it. Both are about a man with power who cannot use it to get the one thing he wants, and both stage restraint better than most shows stage passion. Difference: it stays inside the palace, so there is no war and no separation across a country.

Doomed love with a body count. Same appetite for a romance where politics keeps winning, and the same willingness to let the leads lose. Difference: the fantasy framing and the time-slip device soften the history into legend.

Two people trying to have a private life during a national event. Same collision of tenderness and state violence, compressed into twelve hours. Difference: it is set in 1980 and the ending is not survivable, so it hits harder and faster.

A woman rebuilding her own status inside a rigid system. Same pleasure in period competence and in a romance that has to be negotiated around class. Difference: the tone is adventurous and the stakes are personal rather than national.

Period melodrama with an unresolvable relationship at its centre. Same mournful key and the same interest in what a family will conceal to survive. Difference: it is a mystery first, and the romance is deliberately uncomfortable.

against.title: Moonlight Drawn by Clouds
against.why: The light sageuk default. It is a cheerful palace romance for a young audience; My Dearest spends its second half on famine, captivity and separation.

against.title: Alchemy of Souls
against.why: Paired because it is also a costume drama with a huge following. The magic system and the school comedy have nothing in common with a war melodrama.

against.title: Under the Queen's Umbrella
against.why: Named as the other prestige sageuk of the period. It is a palace politics comedy about mothers and succession, with no romance to speak of.
